page_title: Seodisias - Free SEO Crawler & Website Analyzer

sources.entry: Seodisias - SEO crawler that audits sites for technical issues and optimization opportunities. [![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://seodisias.com)

summary.name: Seodisias
summary.one_liner: Seodisias is a free desktop SEO crawler that runs locally on your machine and audits a website for 30+ technical SEO issues.
use_cases: Find broken links and 4xx/5xx errors across a site
Audit meta titles, descriptions and heading structure
Check canonical, hreflang and meta robots tags
Check AI-readiness with llms.txt and structured data
Produce shareable PDF SEO reports for clients
summary.what_it_does: Seodisias is a desktop application that crawls a website and reports on technical SEO issues such as HTTP status errors, redirects, URL structure, titles and descriptions, headings, images, canonical and hreflang tags, robots meta directives, structured data (JSON-LD and Schema.org), social tags, SSL/HTTPS and mixed content, compression, caching headers, and mobile viewport settings. It can parse nested sitemaps, optionally render JavaScript-heavy pages, and visualize internal links as a force-directed graph. Results can be exported as PDF reports. The page states that crawl data stays on the user's device, with the app contacting its server only for update checks and a news feed.
notable: Runs locally; crawl data stays on the device, no sign-up or account needed
Checks for llms.txt and AI Ready score out of 100
Optional JavaScript rendering for single-page apps
Checksums published for release files; macOS builds are signed and notarized
caveats: Optional paid plans cover extras such as log file analysis, Search Console integration, field speed data and team workflows
Windows and Linux builds are not code-signed yet
Paid tiers are described as planned; the core crawler and audits are said to remain free
